planned_arguments.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished flat opaque landscape 16:9 event poster for neighborhood adults, seen on subway and community digital screens. A confident, welcoming outdoor short-film screening and director conversation, with a distinctive forceful hard-edge graphic system.

Whole design: ink-dark plum field; vivid chartreuse projection light; coral bridge structure; pale warm reversed headline. A substantial cropped flat graphic projector in the lower-left aims its lens toward a visibly supported cinema screen at far right under the bridge. Its one continuous widening beam opens the bridge underside into a cinema and provides the clear bright plane for information. The beam must connect lens to screen coherently, with a spacious boundary rather than a sidebar or decorative frame. Show a small group of seated ADULT viewers grounded on mats along the low edge, and a standing adult speaker beside the screen who visibly holds a microphone with their own hand and forearm. Film screening AND public conversation should be understandable from this connected apparatus/light/screen/audience/speaker scene. Screen has a coherent stand or legs; bridge weight stays near the outer upper crop and never cuts through factual text.

Composition and typography: compact oversized square, heavy Korean headline on left approximately 35% of width, split into two lines at its second word boundary. English immediately below; descriptor below that may wrap only at existing word boundaries into two clear lines. This identity group remains outside the optical beam and above the projector. Right approximately 65% is the expansive clear light plane. Largest useful fact is the time range, followed by its adjacent date and venue immediately below. Participation and preparation form two broad, well-spaced lower light groups. Reserve a broad roughly 600+ design-pixel span for facts; avoid squeezing text into the pointed part of the beam. Reduce apparatus or structure first if needed to protect the copy. Layout dimensions here are optical guidance on a 1280x720 design plane, not a requested pixel output: headline about 78–90 px; English 30 px; descriptor 31–32 px; time 56–58 px; date 38 px; venue 35–37 px; every practical entry 33–36 px. All practical information must stay readable when the whole image is reduced to 720x405. Firm clean sans-serif lettering with comfortable Hangul counters, consistent proportions, complete consonant/vowel strokes, visible word spaces, and generous glyph-to-edge clearance. Make colon dots, range dash and middle dots distinct. Deep plum factual type on clear chartreuse light; do not use texture or silhouettes behind the facts.

Print ONLY these ten entries, each exactly once, verbatim. Quotation marks and the placement instructions are not printed:
Identity title: "다리 아래 영화관"
English: "BRIDGE CINEMA"
Descriptor: "야외 단편 상영 · 감독과의 대화"
Date: "2026.12.05 토요일"
Time: "18:00–20:30"
Venue: "홍제천 연가교 아래"
Entry: "17:30부터 입장"
Preparation: "돗자리 지참"
Capacity: "무료 관람 · 선착순 80명"
Weather: "우천 시 실내로 변경"

Finish: coherent hard flat apparatus, bridge and people; controlled beam/shadow overlap; selective crisp local halftone only in structural shadows and projector surfaces. Intentional sharp boundaries and chromatic impact, energetic evening culture without toy-like forms or childish characters. No added print, labels, credits, logos, QR, watermark, fake fine print, extra text, comparison panel, contact sheet, perspective mockup, frame or physical tape. One separate complete horizontal poster. Do not stretch or crop a portrait design. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력
